author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Maria Delgado's DACA renewal matter M-2024-604 has become urgent because she received a Notice to Appear in removal proceedings while the renewal was pending, and we need to analyze the penalty exposure and enforcement risks. Open the matter file and review Delgado's DACA history, the renewal application status, and any notes about the NTA circumstances. Research immigration enforcement precedents for DACA recipients placed in removal proceedings, focusing on how immigration courts handle cases where the respondent had pending DACA renewals and what bars to relief exist under INA section 240. Pull the full opinions for the strongest BIA and circuit court cases. Look at how courts have analyzed prosecutorial discretion in DACA cases and whether voluntary departure versus removal carries different long-term consequences under the three-year and ten-year inadmissibility bars of section 212(a)(9). Examine the docket of the most relevant removal case for any motions to terminate or administratively close. Draft the penalty analysis memo using the legal drafting tools. Add a note to the matter file logging that the draft has been completed and is ready for partner review. Discuss how the section 212(a)(9) inadmissibility bars apply to DACA recipients in removal proceedings. Analyze voluntary departure as a distinct strategic option, comparing the consequences of accepting voluntary departure against contesting removal, and explain which inadmissibility bar attaches to each outcome. Save the penalty analysis memo as a draft in the matter file so the immigration team can review the removal consequences before advising Maria on next steps. Email the penalty analysis memo to r.whitfield@navarrowhitfield.com once it is drafted so the immigration team can begin advising Maria. Use Delgado DACA Enforcement Risk Analysis as the email subject. The draft must reference the pending renewal receipt number MSC-24-312-74891 and Delgado's Houston address from the vault NTA, and mention her BSN degree from the DACA history document. Use the available tools to carry out every step -- do not simply outline what should be done.
agent_system_prompt: You are an immigration defense associate at Navarro & Whitfield LLP specializing in removal defense and DACA-related litigation. You research enforcement precedents, review matter files, and draft analytical memoranda for the immigration litigation team.
